definitions.explanation: Originally, the small fire used to ignite a cannon or firearm. The literal ignition source.

definitions.gloss: opening shot; trigger; spark that starts something
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, the initial action or remark that triggers a larger event, discussion, or movement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大砲|たいほう}→大砲：12172_taihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口火|くちび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: To light the fuse of a cannon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口火|くちび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。

⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{口火|くちび}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{全国的|ぜんこくてき}→全国的：20017_zenkokuteki⟧な⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: That incident was the spark that started a nationwide protest movement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{口火|くちび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧ことで、⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧にし⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: After she spoke up first, other employees also began voicing their complaints.

notes:
Almost always used in the set phrase {口火|くちび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut the fuse → to be the first to speak/act, to kick things off). The literal meaning (sense 1) is now rare; the figurative sense dominates modern usage. Composed of ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth/opening) + {火|び} (fire).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {口火|くちび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to open (a discussion); to fire the first shot; to be the first to act
- {口火|くちび}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as the trigger/spark for something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皮切|かわき}り→皮切り：13643_kawakiri⟧: the start; the beginning — similar to {口火|くちび} but more neutral; often used in ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{皮切|かわき}り→皮切り：13643_kawakiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (starting with...)
- ⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧: trigger; catalyst — the most common neutral word for what prompts something to happen
- ⟦{発端|ほったん}→発端：14891_hottan⟧: origin; beginning — focuses on the starting point of a series of events
- {導火線|どうかせん}: fuse (literal) — the actual physical fuse of explosives; also used figuratively
